Suspected Responsible Party: NUCOR STEEL CONNECTICUT
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 41.430479, -72.845479 (Approximated from street_address)
Reported Spill Volume: 30 gallon
Report Description
***THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED VIA THE WEB REPORTING SYSTEM*** AT 9:30 PM ON 12/5/13 A HIGH WATER ALARM AT OUR STEEL MANUFACTURING FACILITY WENT OFF. AT THIS POINT CERTAIN PUMPS ARE SUPPOSED TO AUTOMATICALLY SHUTOFF AND PREVENT WATER FROM ENTERING OUR OIL SCAVENGING UNIT. THE PUMPS DID NOT RESPOND TO THE AUTOMATED CONTROL AS THEY USUALLY DO. THE OIL SCAVENGER SYSTEM OVERFLOWED SHORTER AFTER 9:30 PM ON 12/5/13. IT WAS IMMEDIATELY NOTICED AS OUR ELECTRICIANS WERE TROUBLESHOOTING THE ERROR WITH OUR AUTOMATED CONTROLS. OUR SPILL RESPONSE TEAM CONTAINED AND CLEANED THE SPILL IMMEDIATELY THAT NIGHT. IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT 25 GALLONS SPILLED ON TO THE GROUND OUTSIDE OF THE BUILDING. A PORTION OF THIS OIL POSSIBLY 1 GALLON MADE ITS WAY INTO A STORM DRAIN THAT CONNECTS TO OUR PROPERTY'S WEST OUTFALL. THERE WAS NO VISIBLE SHEEN AT AND OIL BOOMS AND OIL TRAPS WERE ALREADY IN PLACE AT OUR OUTFALL. HOWEVER OVER THE COURSE OF THE FOLLOWING DAY. 12/6/12 IT WAS NOTICED THAT THERE WAS OVER A GALLON OF OIL IN OUR OIL TRAP AT THE WEST OUTFALL AND A VISIBLE SHEEN OUTSIDE OF OUR OUTFALL. A VAC TRUCK IS ONSITE NOW CLEANING OUT THE OIL TRAP. OIL BOOMS HAVE BEEN REPLACED AT THE OUTFALL.

Skytruth Analysis

Skytruth Minimum Possible Spill Volume: 5.74 gallons
IN PROCESS OF RETRIEVING PIPELINE PIG STUCK IN 4" OIL EXPORT PIPELINE FROM SAMSON'S VR 272A FACILITY. THE PIPELINE WAS DISPLACED WITH SALTWATER AND THERE WAS A POLLUTION DOME IN PLACE TO CAPTURE ANY FREE PRODUCT WHEN PIPELINE WAS CUT. DIVERS CUT THE PIPELINE IN HALF AND INSTALLED PLUMBERS PLUG IN EACH END OF OPEN PIPE. DIVERS RETURNED TO SURFACE AT 0918 HRS. AT 0935 HRS A SMALL SHEEN WAS NOTICED ON THE SURFACE. DIVERS SENT BACK TO BOTTOM TO SEE WHERE SHEEN WAS COMING FROM. FOUND THE PLUMBERS PLUG HAD BEEN KNOCKED OFF ONE END OF PIPELINE POSSIBLY DUE TO ENDS OF PIPE HITTING EACH OTHER. REINSTALLED A NEW PLUMBER'S PLUG AT 0950HRS TO SECURE THE SOURCE.

THE PIPELINE WAS DISPLACED WITH SALTWATER AND THERE WAS A POLLUTION DOME IN PLACE TO CAPTURE ANY FREE PRODUCT WHEN PIPELINE WAS CUT. DIVERS CUT THE PIPELINE IN HALF AND INSTALLED PLUMBERS PLUG IN EACH END OF OPEN PIPE. DIVERS RETURNED TO SURFACE AT 0918 HRS. AT 0935 HRS A SMALL SHEEN WAS NOTICED ON THE SURFACE. DIVERS SENT BACK TO BOTTOM TO SEE WHERE SHEEN WAS COMING FROM. FOUND THE PLUMBERS PLUG HAD BEEN KNOCKED OFF ONE END OF PIPELINE POSSIBLY DUE TO ENDS OF PIPE HITTING EACH OTHER. REINSTALLED A NEW PLUMBER'S PLUG AT 0950HRS TO SECURE THE SOURCE.

A CLEANUP CREW IS ONSITE.

Incident Type: PLATFORM
Material: ENVIRO-RITE AW HYDRAULIC OIL 22
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: TRANSOCEAN
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 1 gallons
ROV IN WATER WHILE TESTING TETHER CIRCUIT IN 90’ OF WATER AT GI70 LOCATION, HYDRAULIC ALARM WENT OFF AT 0830 IMMEDIATELY SHUT DOWN HYDRAULIC PUMPS. USED THE CAGE/WINCH TO GET THE ROV BACK INTO CAGE. ROV BACK IN CAGE AT 0837. PROCEEDED TO SURFACE. ON DECK AT 0850. UPON INSPECTION OF ROV, IT WAS FOUND THAT ½ STAINLESS STEEL TUBING HAD CAME OUT OF THE SWAGELOC NUT. FERRULE AND BACKUP WERE PRESENT. AFT PORT THRUSTER AT THRUSTER CONTROL UNIT. APPEARS THAT THE NUT FITTING WASN’T PROPERLY TIGHTENED. 60 HOURS OF TOTAL RUN TIME ON HYDRAULIC UNIT. REPLACED WITH NEW NUT/FERRULE COMBINATION. PREDIVE CHECKS CONDUCTED AT 0953.
